baseinsurance.config.title: Base Insurance Settings
baseinsurance.config.enabled.desc: Turns all of Base Insurance on or off. Your bases and history are kept either way.
baseinsurance.config.live_alerts.desc: Alert when blocks in a base change while you're there and you didn't do it.
baseinsurance.config.count_own: Alert me about my own changes
baseinsurance.config.count_own.desc: Normally blocks you break or place go straight into the snapshot. Turn this on to have them reported like anyone else's.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_near.desc: Live changes within this many blocks of you count as yours (handy for TNT, pistons or water you're using). Off = only blocks you directly touch.
baseinsurance.config.live_min.desc: Only alert when at least this many blocks change at once. Smaller changes are still logged in the report's timeline.
baseinsurance.config.live_cooldown.desc: Wait at least this long between live alerts for the same base; changes in between are grouped into one alert.
baseinsurance.config.arrival_reports.des: When you come back, report everything that changed while you were away.
baseinsurance.config.all_clear.desc: When you come back and nothing changed, say so.
baseinsurance.config.all_clear_away.desc: Only say "all clear" if you were away at least this long, so walking to the edge of render distance and back doesn't spam you.
baseinsurance.config.player_alerts.desc: Alert when another player (not a friend) comes near one of your bases.
Only alert for players actually inside a base's area, not just near it.
baseinsurance.config.player_distance.des: How close to a base's edge another player has to be to trigger an alert.
baseinsurance.config.player_cooldown.des: How long before the same player near the same base alerts again.
baseinsurance.config.theft_alerts.desc: Alert when a container you've opened before is missing items. Always recorded in the report either way.
baseinsurance.config.alert_style.desc: Chat keeps a history you can scroll back through; the action bar is the text above your hotbar.
baseinsurance.config.self_edit: My edits count as mine for
baseinsurance.config.self_edit.desc: After you break or place a block, changes to it (and the blocks touching it) for this long are treated as yours. Raise it if slow things like falling sand or redstone you trigger get reported.
baseinsurance.config.natural_note: These change on their own, so changes to or from them are ignored. Turn one off if you want to know about it (for example, someone stealing your crops).
baseinsurance.config.ignore_plants.desc: Grass, flowers, crops, saplings, leaves, vines, sugar cane, bamboo, cactus, kelp, pumpkins, melons, mushrooms, amethyst buds and similar.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_weather.desc: Fire, soul fire, snow layers, powder snow and bubble columns.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_fluids.desc: Flowing (non-source) water and lava. Source blocks are always tracked, so a lava cast still shows up.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_ores.desc: Many servers hide ores by swapping them with stone, or add fake ores. Ignores stone/ore swaps so underground doesn't light up.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_pistons.desc: Moving pistons and piston heads. The blocks a piston moves are still tracked.
baseinsurance.config.track_containers.de: Remember what's in your chests, barrels and shulker boxes so missing items and destroyed containers can be reported.
baseinsurance.config.scan_speed.desc: How many blocks are checked per second. Higher finds changes faster on big bases but uses more CPU.
baseinsurance.config.build_auto_off.desc: Turn build mode off automatically when you're more than 64 blocks from all your bases, so you can't forget it.
baseinsurance.config.auto_overlay.desc: Turn the overlay on automatically when you come back to a damaged base.
baseinsurance.config.overlay_range.desc: Only draw changed blocks within this distance.
baseinsurance.config.overlay_fill.desc: Fill changed blocks with colour, not just outline them.
baseinsurance.config.aim_info.desc: Aim at a changed block (with the overlay on) to see what belongs there.
baseinsurance.config.hud_status.desc: The "Home: 12 blocks to fix" line while you're at a base.
baseinsurance.config.hud_corner.desc: Which top corner the status line and build-mode warning go in.
baseinsurance.config.record_map.desc: Draw chunks into the map as you explore. Turn off to keep the map as it is.
baseinsurance.config.map_speed.desc: Chunks drawn per second. Higher fills the map faster when you fly into new areas.
baseinsurance.config.map_damage.desc: Show each changed block as a coloured dot on the map when zoomed in.
baseinsurance.config.map_grid.desc: Show chunk lines when zoomed in far.
baseinsurance.config.friend_add.desc: Friends never trigger player alerts and aren't listed as suspects. Type their exact username.
baseinsurance.config.ignored_add.desc: Changes to or from this block are never reported. Type an id like cobblestone or minecraft:torch.
baseinsurance.config.max_events.desc: How many timeline events each base keeps.
baseinsurance.config.open_folder.desc: Open the folder with your bases, snapshots and map files.
baseinsurance.config.ignore_hidden.desc: Ignore blocks completely surrounded by solid blocks. Nobody can see those, and servers with anti-xray constantly swap or fake them, which otherwise shows up as thousands of changes. Anything you dig into becomes exposed and is tracked again.
baseinsurance.config.smart_terrain.desc: Some servers send air instead of underground terrain until you're close. With this on, natural stone, dirt, ores and so on appearing where the snapshot had air are treated as the real terrain loading in, a section snapshotted while hidden is re-snapshotted, and far-off terrain turning to air is ignored until you're near. Building blocks, lava and water placed on their own are still reported.
